amendment.original_definition: indicator(any of 15 round candidates valid) minus indicator(final valid)
amendment.problem: A synthesized final can be valid even when no round-agent candidate is valid, making the original difference negative and therefore not an upper bound for a selector that can retain the current final.
amendment.change: Add the realized final to the oracle support, so headroom is max(final, 15 round candidates) minus final.
amendment.timing: Made after the first cohort summaries were inspected and before paper integration.
amendment.analysis_status: Cohort-specific reanalysis with a mathematically corrected estimand; exploratory cross-cohort headroom synthesis remains explicitly outcome-aware.

cohorts.deepseek_x1: All 60 completed runs, reported by arm.
cohorts.deepseek_nondegenerate: The 48 main-phase runs only, reported by four arms.
cohorts.deepseek_execution_confirmatory: All 40 completed runs, reported by two arms.
cohorts.qwen_length: Reuse frozen artifact 078 for the 40 main-phase runs.

recoverability.candidate_surface: Exactly 15 fast-round agent output_text slots plus runtime_result.final_answer.
recoverability.semantic_denominator: Runs whose offline reference is a feasible action list. IMPOSSIBLE-reference runs remain in candidate diversity and reference-exact secondary analyses but are excluded from semantic headroom because the frozen executor cannot certify non-existence. This clarification is made before DeepSeek candidate inspection.
recoverability.headroom: Within-run indicator(final or any round candidate valid) minus indicator(final valid). Including the realized final makes the candidate-pool oracle weakly dominate the current finalizer.
recoverability.interpretation_guard: An empirical upper bound for selectors restricted to the persisted candidate pool under the fixed generation process; not a bound on methods that generate or repair new candidates.
recoverability.uncertainty: 100,000-draw run bootstrap within each arm plus two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson intervals for binary headroom incidence.

primary: exact-text unique candidates and duplicate-slot rate within each 16-slot run
canonical parsed-plan unique candidates and duplicate rate among parseable slots
same-round inter-agent exact-match rate and character SequenceMatcher similarity
diversity.scope: Descriptive mechanism analysis; no claim that lexical identity exhausts reasoning diversity.

completeness_proxy.predictor: Mean per-slot released length component: 0.85 * min(1, output_chars / 800).
completeness_proxy.outcome: Malformed synthesized final under the deterministic PlanCraft parser.
analyses: well-formed versus malformed predictor means by cohort
AUC for predicting a well-formed final
pooled linear-probability coefficient with cohort fixed effects and a stratified bootstrap interval
paired malformed differences for length-zero minus original
completeness_proxy.interpretation_guard: Associational mechanism check, not a causal mediation estimate.

pooled_length_effect.primary: Stratified paired risk difference, length-zero minus original, over 42 pairs.
pooled_length_effect.uncertainty: 100,000 stratified paired bootstrap draws, resampling pairs within each cohort.
pooled_length_effect.discordance: Combined exact sign/binomial test plus cohort-specific discordant counts.
pooled_length_effect.heterogeneity: Report cohort effects, range, and DeepSeek-nondegenerate minus Qwen contrast with stratified bootstrap interval; do not pool silently.
pooled_length_effect.claim_rule: Describe a precise pooled null only if the interval contains zero and its upper endpoint is at most 0.15; otherwise report the observed interval without the precise-null label.

scope_guard: Outcome-aware secondary reanalysis of frozen cached cohorts; no prospective method claim.
